reviewer: Claude stored caption and figure comparison at reduced size; not a radiologist review
decision: On 2026-11-18 the project owner asked for the figures unlocked by the context-code repair to be bound.
rule: A figure unlocked by the context-code repair is bound to a structure or finding requirement when a sentence of its published caption or stored source note names it, the sentence is about a selected panel, the fidelity checker finds no modality, state or side conflict, and the figure was looked at. A stated side binds that side; an unstated side binds each side only where the two sides are mirror images. Coverage is always partial.
method: Names of the requirements of each figure’s investigations, and of the listed parts of finding requirements, were matched against the stored descriptions of the 181 repaired figures that have one, allowing spelling variants and word forms. 931 candidate pairs on 156 figures were read; 876 of them passed the checker. Pairs the same captions name in other words were added. Each accepted figure was looked at on a contact sheet; after that look three bindings were withdrawn, nine were added where a selected panel carries a letter the legend spells out or both parametria are labelled, and the panels of one figure were narrowed.
mirror_image_regions: A binding whose caption states no side rests on the mirror-image assumption only in the sinuses, the orbits, the temporal lobes and hippocampi, the pharyngeal lateral walls, the cervical oesophagus, the parametria, the pelvic sidewalls and the obturator internus muscles.

evidence_values.listed_term: the quoted sentence uses a term that the requirement lists among its required parts; listed_parts names those parts

side_values.side_not_stated: the record and the caption state no side; bound on the mirror-image assumption
side_values.record_states_side: the figure record itself states the matching side
side_values.not_sided: the requirement has no left or right side

not_bound.catch_all_requirements: Requirements for “every other” or “each other” items, measurements, comparisons and acquisition descriptors are not bound.
not_bound.abbreviations: A structure named only by a letter or abbreviation is bound only where the caption spells it out and a selected panel carries it; “USL” is not spelled out, so only the sentence that says “uterosacral” is used.
not_bound.side_conflict: Orbit MRI figure 13 of PMC6095049: the caption states a left lesion, but the cyst lies on the patient’s right in the article’s own display convention, so neither side is bound.
not_bound.mirror_image: An unsided oesophageal pouch above the diaphragm is not bound: the lower thoracic oesophagus is not a mirror-image region.
not_bound.checker: 55 caption matches still fail the checker: 28 are in a modality outside the requirement’s scope (for example CT and PET-CT figures matched to MRI investigations), 19 are on context-only figures that the repair left refused, 5 are on the other side from the one the record states and 3 are normal figures matched to a finding.
not_bound.models: The 69 repaired 3D models are reference-only records without a caption; binding them needs a separate review of each model’s source label.
